sentences.text: The learned APP seeks time to verify criminal antecedents of  the present applicant.
The learned counsel for the applicant submits that the  applicant is the owner of the truck and he has nothing to do with  the seized tobacco products as the truck was given on hire to  transporter.
He further submits that nothing is to be recovered at  the instance of the applicant and hence there is no need of  custodial interrogation of the applicant.
5. Considering the above facts and as the learned APP is seeking  time, I am inclined to grant interim anticipatory bail to the  applicant till the next date of hearing.

ORDER (i) In the event of arrest of applicant-Mohammed Gaus Ismail Mohammed in connection with Crime No.368 of 2022 registered at Solapur Police Station, Solapur Rural for the offences punishable under Sections 328, 188, 272, 273 of the Indian Penal Code and under Sections 26(2)(i), 26(2)(iv),
27(3)(e), 59 of the Food Safety and Standard Act, 2006, he shall be released on bail on furnishing P.R. Bond in the sum of Rs.25,000/- (Rs. Twenty Five Thousand only) with one or two sureties in the like amount.
6. List the application for further consideration on 15 November, 2022.
( N.R. BORKAR, J. )
